channel.title: apollyon class scps
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "apollyon class scps" - Do you think the object class Apollyon was a good idea, why or why not?

item.title: Re: apollyon class scps
item.content:encoded: It's hard to paint all Apollyon articles with the same brush since they tend to go in radically different directions with their stories. Personally, I find the class more interesting because of the challenge that it provides to the author — you know, you're kind of expected to write to justify the usage of Apollyon, in a certain sense, which is an extra hurdle you put in front of yourself with the hopes it pays off.

item.title: apollyon class scps
item.content:encoded: I've read every single apollyon class because personally I find them interesting HOWEVER it is a huge double-edged sword as it's so powerful it's cliche. For example, a few of them I found a personal favorite such as S. D. Locke's proposal and SCP-5055. Do you find them interesting? Why or why not? If so, what are your favorites?
